prompts.name: white-bells
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: Muguetli luxury literary journal cover, landscape 3:2. Primary request: a meaningful photographic still life about the paradoxical lily of the valley and transformation. Subject: a delicate living arch of white lily-of-the-valley bell flowers and deep green leaves emerging from dark earth in a low sculptural charcoal vessel, resting on flowing ivory silk, a tiny ember-colored reflection on the silk and a quiet ripple of water nearby, air suggested by the lifting silk edge. Scene: refined artist's atelier, warm off-white plaster with a muted plum shadow, restrained teal reflected light. Composition: close editorial art photograph with generous breathing room, flowers the clear hero, tactile botanical realism, quiet cinematic side lighting. No text, letters, logo, watermark, collage, infographic, or mock website. Do not depict a commercial product or packaging.
